notes.title: New Update v0.15.4 with bugfixes ⚙️
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/7e275d03a4d4057dfb71c74947055be2a567076d.jpg
Warmest greetings to all WANDERER: Broken Bed fans 😊 We have good news for you!

We are now still working on Act II. New stories, quests, characters, intricacies of plot and balance... Well, you know: A LOT OF WORK. However, we don't forget about bugs and errors. So here we'll tell you what we've managed to find and fix 😉


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2485860/WANDERER_Broken_Bed

We have tried to get rid of all the bugs that players reported. We’ve also spent quite a lot of time on additional testing afterwards. These are some of the BUGS that were very common and also have been FIXED:
 Overlapping dialog with Tybalt on the H-scene with Catrine in the infirmary
 Closed wing was not opened after completing a certain main quest
 Combat with Calem didn't end after the timer expired
 Some fights in the dungeon didn't end even after the death of all enemies
 Bodies of enemies didn't disappear after killing them, thus overlapping with the HP bar of other enemies
 “Furry Thief” quest didn't count as finished in the jounal after completing it
 Creating a potion sometimes didn't count for the assignment, which broke the mini-game

HUGE thank you to all those who send bug reports on our Discord server. The game becomes better and better yet with your help ❤️

❗️ If you are still not sure where to write about bugs or other questions about the game, then welcome to our Discord: https://discord.gg/tophouse

notes.title: BIG UPDATE - WANDERER: Broken Bed v0.15 - Act I complete
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/49b74c63ab94f436a48b38f79872b0d72a6f6879.jpg

Hello everyone! 💕
Today is a historic day for all Wanderer fans: v0.15 is out and Act I of our story is complete. The finish of the first act sets up for any future adventures, and for any romantic routes.

You can try out the freshest build right now with all the new features:
  New and old H-scenes: 9 scenes in total
 New languages: French and Simplified Chinese
 New reward types for daily classes
 New battle cards: 9 total
 Choice system in dialogues
 Schedule system for classes
 13 new main quests, 7 character quests and 6 sidequests
 Updated Closed Wing dungeon
 MC room upgrade system
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2485860/WANDERER_Broken_Bed

And now in more detail:

1. New and old H-scenes: 9 scenes in total
We’ll add 9 H-scenes - some of them are already familiar to you, but were cut due to various reasons, and some of them are brand new

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/ce05e9a6c6e30f0e9fcb33af6a07bc6aa0266d4e.jpg

2. New languages: French and Simplified Chinese
Apart from Russian, English, Brazillian Portuguese, Polish and Spanish, we’ll be adding Simplified Chinese and French.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/d83cf0b81db21f4c4703facb84ed976f58a20b9c.png

3. New reward types for daily classes
We’ve made three new types of rewards that change every week for players to complete their classes with more enjoyment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/7b8fd2438ca89657cd2551805ff55af95abac24c.png

4. New battle cards: 9 in total
Since the beginning of January, we have managed to draw and add mechanics to 9 new battle cards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/f959f9b8ea0ebb20240b6960c1fa8d181da3362d.jpg

5. Choice system in dialogues
It will appear in new quests, directing your romantic routes in this Act and influencing your relationships in the two subsequent Acts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/b3606adac537745f6e89a749add50f3b00a3fa4b.jpg

6. Schedule system for classes
Thanks to our new schedule system, you can spend more time studying in the Academy. It will help you get more potions, magical scrolls and battle EXP every week.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/241fe52b0f085298feea53320c4b90a8773b183f.png

7. 13 new main quests, 7 character quests and 6 sidequests
We have written 26 new quests and have already integrated them into the game, so now you can plunge into the continuation of this wonderful story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/215881b18851683ef4bb3a31057f61fa10b421a0.png

8. Updated Closed Wing dungeon
We have ovehauled both the balance side of the dungeon and its visuals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/a1b74ee85da1a2ac44119b0ada3b92bf7934322e.png

9. MC room upgrade system
Thanks to this mechanic, you can finally make your pitiful mesy room into a real elite student’s den (if your budget suports it).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/964feb4f38f25b236586d009160dab4f613ff902.png

More content is coming: Act II, new main quest-related characters, new adventures and even more cool and sexy situations with the girls.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47280/WANDERER_Broken_Bed__FANTASY_EDITION
